teaser.en: Eat the ripe pulp, never the seeds, then dry the shell and you have a musical rattle.
teaser.sw: Kula nyama ya tunda lililoiva, kamwe si mbegu, kisha kausha ganda lake na utapata kayamba la muziki.

summary.en: *Muhonga*, the spiny monkey orange, is a thorny small tree of dry woodland and coastal bush with large round fruits that ripen yellow. The ripe pulp is eaten, the dry shell becomes a rattle, and the roots repel insects.
summary.sw: *Muhonga*, au *mtonga*, ni mti mdogo wenye miiba wa mapori makavu na vichaka vya pwani wenye matunda makubwa ya mviringo yanayogeuka njano yanapoiva. Nyama ya tunda lililoiva huliwa, ganda lililokauka hugeuka kayamba, na mizizi hufukuza wadudu.

about.en: *Muhonga* is a thorny tree 2 to 5 metres tall. The leaves are round and leathery, with three to five veins running from the base. The fruit is large, round and hard-shelled, about the size of an orange, turning yellow as it ripens.
about.sw: *Muhonga* ni mti wenye miiba wenye urefu wa mita 2 hadi 5. Majani yake ni ya mviringo na magumu kama ngozi, yakiwa na mishipa mitatu hadi mitano inayoanzia kwenye kitako cha jani. Tunda ni kubwa, la mviringo na lenye ganda gumu, karibu ukubwa wa chungwa, na hugeuka njano linapoiva.

where.en: It grows in dry woodland and coastal bushland.
where.sw: Huota katika mapori makavu na vichaka vya pwani.

uses.en:
The ripe fruit pulp is eaten. The unripe fruit and the seeds are poisonous, so only the pulp of ripe fruit is eaten.

The dry shell is made into a musical rattle. The roots are used to repel insects, and the plant is used in traditional medicine.
uses.sw:
Nyama ya tunda lililoiva huliwa. Tunda bichi na mbegu ni sumu, kwa hiyo ni nyama ya tunda lililoiva tu inayoliwa.

Ganda lililokauka hutengenezwa kuwa kayamba la muziki. Mizizi hutumika kufukuza wadudu, na mmea huu hutumika katika tiba ya jadi.

names.en: Pakia and the ICRAF handbook give the Digo name *muhonga*, with *mursapungu* as another name. *Muhonga* is also listed as a name for the black monkey orange, *mkpwakpwa*. In Swahili it is *mtonga*, and in Giriama *mujaje*. In English it is the spiny monkey orange.
names.sw: Pakia na kitabu cha ICRAF vinatoa jina la Kidigo *muhonga*, na *mursapungu* kama jina jingine. *Muhonga* pia limeorodheshwa kama jina la *black monkey orange*, *mkpwakpwa*. Kwa Kiswahili unaitwa *mtonga*, na kwa Kigiriama *mujaje*. Kwa Kiingereza unaitwa *spiny monkey orange*.

reason.sw: Black monkey orange, wa jenasi moja

reason.en: Another wild fruit of the bush
reason.sw: Tunda jingine la porini la vichakani
